scenarios.user: Gather process (scheduled station and sido collection)
scenarios.goal: Store fresh AirKorea observations although the last configured key is expired
scenarios.prerequisites: AIRKOREA_SECRET_KEYS contains at least one valid key; provider reachable
steps: Scheduler calls /gather/keco
Client tries the last key and receives HTTP 401 DEADLINE_HAS_EXPIRED_ERROR
Client logs KEY_REJECTED with key position and code
Client retries the previous key and receives result code 00
Collector validates and stores station rows and province aggregates
scenarios.expected: Fresh station and province rows; later requests start with the working key
scenarios.failure: If no key is valid the province fails with NO_VALID_KEY and nothing is written

scenarios.prerequisites: Working key has reached its daily quota
steps: Collector requests a province
Provider returns result code 22
scenarios.expected: Request fails with PROVIDER_22 after one call; no other key is tried
scenarios.failure: Switching keys on quota would bypass the quota; the test rejects that

scenarios.goal: Recognize that no configured key works
scenarios.prerequisites: All configured keys expired or unregistered
steps: Collector requests a province
Every key is rejected
scenarios.expected: NO_VALID_KEY outcome and one KEY_REJECTED line per key, without key text
scenarios.failure: Key text in logs or a reported success would be a defect

scenarios.goal: Refresh station metadata from the supported service
steps: startManager calls getAllMsrStnInfo
Client pages getMsrstnList until totalCount
Stations are stored with geo [lon, lat]
scenarios.expected: All stations stored; Seoul stations near 127E 37.5N
scenarios.failure: An incomplete page rejects the batch; startup continues and logs the code

scenarios.goal: Store the latest dust forecast announcement
scenarios.prerequisites: Valid key; announcement for the expected KST time published
steps: Collector checks the stored announcement time
Client pages getMinuDustFrcstDspth for the date
Rows of the expected announcement are parsed and saved
Hourly forecast image controller runs
scenarios.expected: Forecast documents with region grades and nine image URLs; dust forecast readable by kecoController.getDustFrcst
scenarios.failure: Partial pages (provider default 10 rows) are rejected rather than stored

scenarios.goal: Roll out and verify on the gather host
steps: Confirm the gather host key list contains the valid key
Deploy the revision
Observe one scheduled station/sido run and read back rows
Check Seoul coordinate and nation responses
scenarios.expected: Successful outcome records and fresh readback
scenarios.failure: NO_VALID_KEY or missing rows stop the rollout; rollback restores the previous revision
